releaseName: Quality Microtask Engine with Local-Safe Completion

analysisArchitecture.aiContribution: three core deep-analysis tasks, one monitoring task, and one independent microtask per deterministic quality tool
analysisArchitecture.reconciliation: incremental field-level merge; a failed optional quality microtask falls back to the deterministic local interpretation without blocking report completion

automaticRecovery.contentFailureHandling: core full tasks split by target batches; quality content failure completes with deterministic local interpretation

runtime.qualityTaskPolicy: one task per quality tool, maximum two in parallel, content failure uses local deterministic interpretation
runtime.segmentedPipeline: four parent axes; quality is represented by one independent microtask per deterministic quality tool

acceptanceCoverage.adaptiveFallback: new-form profiling, relevant exploratory analysis, data requests and contract proposal
acceptanceCoverage.scoreReconciliation: exactly 4 diagnostic sections, 5 findings, 4 interventions and 4 monitoring stages
acceptanceCoverage.duplicatePrevention: Gemini cannot create parallel score interventions or monitoring cycles
acceptanceCoverage.invalidTargetHandling: unknown target IDs are rejected before reconciliation
acceptanceCoverage.reportOutput: one reconciled analysis, six print-safe pages for the score fixture
acceptanceCoverage.masteryFixture: 268 valid, 48 mastered, 220 not mastered, 17.91044776119403% raw spread, 17.9% display
acceptanceCoverage.segmentedPipeline: four parent axes; score fixture creates 10 tasks: 3 core, 6 per-tool quality microtasks, and 1 monitoring task
acceptanceCoverage.partialFailure: quality content failure uses local deterministic interpretation and does not block completion; core task failures remain isolated and named
acceptanceCoverage.automaticRecovery: core content failures decompose by targets; transient failures receive one bounded retry; quality content failure never loops
acceptanceCoverage.nonRetryableFailure: 401/configuration failure is not retried or hidden by local fallback

performance.resultsPresentation: deterministic results first, isolated Gemini tasks with max concurrency three, incremental reconciliation
performance.expectedBenefit: no 73-second identical retry loop; smaller governance payloads and exact failed-task diagnosis
performance.cacheGranularity: one cache entry per isolated task
performance.retryGranularity: failed task only; content failures decompose, transient failures retry once
performance.recoveryBackoff: one bounded transient retry with Retry-After support; no repeated identical content payloads

backwardCompatibility.previousFrontend: v0.9.2 segmented clients remain compatible with enrich_segment
